name: Reedmarch Kin
languages: Common plus one other language, Draconic

abilities.name: Pack Signal
abilities.description: While the kin or any ally it can see is within reach of a creature, that creature can't benefit from being unseen by the kin, and the kin ignores the effect of cover from mud, reeds, or shallow water when it makes a Perception check to find a hidden foe.

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.description: The kin can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Marsh Stride
abilities.description: Difficult Terrain composed of mud doesn't cost the kin extra movement, and the kin can move across mud without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Patient Defense (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: The kin takes the Dodge action.

abilities.name: Cunning Action (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: The kin takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The kin makes two attacks: one with its Unarmed Strike and one with its Dart.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (6d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Once on each of the kin's turns when it hits with this attack, the target is subjected to the following effect. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is stunned until the end of the kin's next turn.

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage. Until the end of the kin's next turn, the kin has advantage on attack rolls against the target, and the target can't take the Hide action.
